title: Constraint & grid backtracking
learn: backtracking on a grid (mark/unmark visited), partitioning, pruning
hook: Word Search and Palindrome Partitioning are among the most common backtracking mediums, and N-Queens is the classic hard. They add constraints and pruning to the basic template, plus the mark/unmark trick for grids.

explain.prompt: Explain how you'd solve Word Search with backtracking, including how you avoid reusing a cell and what the complexity is.
keyPoints: DFS from every cell that matches the first letter
at each step the next letter must be in one of the 4 neighbours
mark the cell while it's on the current path, unmark it when backtracking so other paths can use it
prune immediately on out-of-bounds, mismatch or a visited cell
O(m·n·3^L) worst case, O(L) recursion depth
